race.comment: SILENT DIVA (5) got the job done last start, winning by 0.2L when jumping the race favourite in a race that looked hers to win. This shapes similarly today for CJP, drawing inside again and she can continue to improve through the grades. Rates highly on that effort and can go back-to-back. REFEMME NO ANGEL (11) was trending the right way before a disappointing effort most recently. Stepping back up to 1400m is a big tick now and he looks set to return to his best form. Happy to forgive one bad run. DEEL HER IN (6) flew home to just miss over 1300m and should be better suited over 1400m this time. Steve Parnham sticks with her and it wouldn't surprise to see her end her winning drought. SEARCHIN' TIMES (7) was a little better last start off a freshen, hinting that her best form is just around the corner. Can continue to build. BRAVE SPIRIT (4) can improve out in trip.
